defects.what: Face reads as a flat planar slab with a hard vertical crease (tile 1 centre); looks like a cut block, not weathered boulder
defects.fix: Break the plane with 20-30 cm undulations and round the crease edge

defects.what: Rectangular step/notch with two dark vertical shadow bands looks like a stacked box
defects.fix: Round the notch corners and give it a sloped fracture face

defects.what: Moss/lichen blotch noise is uniform and soft, slightly blurry; ~10 m footprint with texture stretched
defects.fix: Add larger-scale moss gradient concentrated on top and crevices, sharper fine grain

assets.read_at_game_distance: Reads as a mossy boulder; planar faces are noticeable up close.

defects.what: Silhouette is a faceted pyramid/wedge with hard planar creases (tile 1 centre ridge, tile 2 apex); looks low-poly blocked
defects.fix: Add secondary chips, rounded breaks and uneven ridge line; avoid single apex

defects.what: Top is a flat slab with a pinched dent and ragged right-hand lip, reads as clay
defects.fix: Re-sculpt top with a tilted fracture plane and sharper broken edge

defects.what: Same speckled moss texture everywhere, no directional wear (no streaking, no moss concentrated at base)
defects.fix: Add rain streaks and darker damp band at base; moss on upper ledges

assets.read_at_game_distance: Reads as rock but the pyramid wedge shape looks artificial.

defects.where: All tiles, 2.51 m long and 1.49 m tall, saw frame behind log
defects.what: Whole thing is oversized for a sawhorse (about 2.5 m span); the log is 2.5 m and the saw frame floats on the log with only a thin post touching it (tile 1, tile 6)
defects.fix: Shorten to ~1.0-1.2 m beam and 0.8 m height, or keep log but make horse proportioned; seat saw frame into a kerf in the log with blade visible

defects.what: Leg pairs do not join the top beam with notches; legs splay inconsistently and cross braces are short stubs that look pinned on
defects.fix: Cut birdsmouth notches at the beam and run cross braces between leg pairs with visible nails

defects.what: Bark knots repeat at even spacing along the log top
defects.fix: Randomise knot spacing and sizes

assets.read_at_game_distance: Reads as a log on trestles, scale feels off.

defects.what: Blade has an odd cut notch on the top edge that reads as a defect, not wear
defects.fix: Make it a clean bend or tear with rust at the edge

defects.what: Ferrule sleeve is thick rust-orange cylinder with identical round rivets, looks like pasted tube
defects.fix: Taper the socket into the blade with a seam and vary rust

defects.what: D-handle is a thin flat triangle, too light and open
defects.fix: Thicken to a closed grip with a cross bar

assets.read_at_game_distance: Reads clearly as a rusty shovel lying on the ground.

defects.what: Growth rings are a uniform wavy sand ripple pattern repeated across the whole top, reads like sand or fingerprint, not wood
defects.fix: Use irregular ring spacing, radial cracks and darker heartwood

defects.what: Axe handle is about 1.4 m and leans sharply; head looks like a tiny wedge with little bite into the wood, the handle ends in an odd pointed knob (tile 6)
defects.fix: Shorten handle to ~0.9 m, embed a proper axe bit with visible kerf, and round the knob end

defects.what: Small grey crosses and dashes on the top look like random decals
defects.fix: Remove or turn into real splinters and chips

assets.read_at_game_distance: Reads as stump with axe, but top texture looks like sand.

defects.what: Sidewall is a lumpy slab with vertical streaks, no tread, no sidewall lettering or ridges; reads as a rubber blob
defects.fix: Model a rounded torus with tread blocks, bead rings and moulded sidewall detail

defects.what: Centre is a pure black void, no rim bead edge or inner liner visible
defects.fix: Show inner bead lip and a lighter inner sidewall

defects.what: A patch of beige texture inside the hole looks like a stray decal
defects.fix: Replace with leaf litter or dirt that has a cause

assets.read_at_game_distance: Reads as a tire from afar but crude; the shape is a lumpy cylinder.

defects.what: Lid is a flat brown plate sitting inside the box rim, textured with camouflage-like blotches that are unrelated to the red paint
defects.fix: Make lid same red metal with a hinge and edge lip, rust only at edges

defects.what: Two thin crossed rods float on the lid like loose sticks, and the handle has a single tall post at one end
defects.fix: Remove rods; mount handle on two brackets at each end

defects.what: Latches are flat tabs without hasp or catch
defects.fix: Add a hinged hasp with a rivet

assets.read_at_game_distance: Reads as a red box with a lid, muddy blotches on top.

defects.what: Figure hangs from a hook with spindly stick bundle; legs and arms are thin sticks that look sparse and unconnected, with arm ends floating (tile 1)
defects.fix: Bind arms and legs to the torso with visible lashing and thicken limbs

defects.what: Post carries small evenly spaced tick marks like a ladder pattern
defects.fix: Vary notch spacing or make them clear carvings

defects.what: Beam is only butted to posts, no notch or lashing visible
defects.fix: Add a notched joint with rope wraps or bolts

assets.read_at_game_distance: Reads as an eerie hanging effigy on a gallows frame; effective silhouette.

defects.what: Plaque is tiny with a blank beige square above an arrow; looks like a placeholder
defects.fix: Add a painted blaze or trail number and fasten with visible nails

defects.what: Post is straight uniform cylinder with regular band marks at even spacing
defects.fix: Add taper, a cut top bevel and irregular knots

defects.what: Plaque is paper-thin with no fasteners
defects.fix: Thicken and add two nail heads

assets.read_at_game_distance: Reads as a wooden post with a small sign; plaque too small to read.

defects.what: Handles run level with plain legs; leg posts are square sticks that stop short of the frame with unclear joints, and handle ends are black tubes
defects.fix: Add a leg bracket bolted to the handle, curved handle and wood grip ends

defects.what: Tray sits on rusty brackets above the frame with air gaps between tray and wood
defects.fix: Seat tray on the cross members with bolts through its underside

defects.what: Pale grey scuffs repeat on the tray interior in identical diagonal dashes
defects.fix: Vary scuff direction and add rust at the seams and the bottom

assets.read_at_game_distance: Reads clearly as a wheelbarrow; bright grey tray is a bit clean for the wear.
